title: Dead time with luggage around cruise day
friction: Passengers arrive hours before boarding (or leave the ship hours before their flight) with nothing to do and their luggage in tow.
who: Cruise passengers flying into or out of Miami on sailing days
howSolvedToday: Waiting at the terminal or airport; a few hotels hold bags; ad-hoc taxis.
evidence: F-ben-03 record volume; F-ana-03 dead time (source to find).
author: Ana
